description: Finds overlaps between Jupiter transiting the natal seventh sign and Venus or seventh-lord Vimshottari periods. Also returns the natal marriage promise and marriageTiming: ranked month-level windows (period activation times transit trigger, with the Saturn-Jupiter double transit) with their widths and the facts behind each. Returns planning windows, never a guaranteed marriage prediction.
